newsitem.title: USA: Eagle Financial adopts shareholder plan.
newsitem.headline: Eagle Financial adopts shareholder plan.

text.p: Eagle Financial Corp said Thursday that its board has adopted a shareholder rights plan to protect shareholders in the event of an attempted takeover.
The plan would go into effect if someone acquires 15 percent or more of the company's common stock or if the board decides an "adverse" person or group has acquired 10 percent or more, Eagle said.

Eagle said the plan gives a dividend of one right for each outstanding share of Eagle common, and each right would initially entitle the holder to buy one 1/1000th of a share of preferred stock at an exercise price of $100.
The rights will expire October 22, 2006, Eagle said.
The plan is not being adopted in response to any acquisition proposal, said Chief Financial Officer Mark Blum.
